title: Dell Terraform Provider for PowerFlex, versions prior to 1.9.0, contains a vulnerability that may permit the use of…
description: Dell Terraform Provider for PowerFlex versions prior to 1.9.0 contain a vulnerability that may allow the use of deprecated cryptographic protocols during secure communications. This could potentially be exploited by an unauthenticated remote attacker to expose information. The vulnerability has a low severity rating and does not impact integrity or availability.
